_comment: scripts/lint/orphan_header_check.py: engine/godot-src headers included by nothing outside tests/ and their own unit that are NOT staged policy code. Each entry names why it has no include consumer. The 2026-08-25 census debt was burned down on 2026-08-27 (threedi_compare moved to tests/threedi/, terrain/types.h deleted, serializing_sink.h STAGED with its owner named); never grow this list without a reason that names the consumer.

allow.engine/base/resource_index/file_kind.h: The typed kinds and their loader facts (the names that give a kind, its archive, its place under an expansion, its line reader), which the editor's asset kinds read their facts from (engine/editor/assets/asset_kind.h, asset_kinds.cpp, asset_type_registry.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/cpt/trngen/heightmap_dept: A heightmap image (a PNG at any depth, TrnGen's .raw, the game's raw16) made into the depth the TrnGen bake takes, which the editor's terrain import reads a terrain set's heightmap with (engine/editor/import/terrain_import.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/fnt/fnt_sheet.h: A glyph sheet made into a bitmap font, which the editor's font import makes a font set's .fnt with (engine/editor/import/font_import.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/trn/trn_source_issue.h: The .trn readers' report of the lines they read otherwise than TrnConfig holds, which the editor's terrain document turns into its source findings (engine/editor/documents/terrain_document.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/runtime/hud/hud_element_layout.h: Which hudpos.def values place each HUD element, which the editor's HUD layout editing and HUD viewport move and resize elements by (engine/editor/preview/hud_layout_edit.cpp, engine/editor/preview/hud_viewport.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/runtime/terrain/terrain_map_sourc: A terrain's char map and foliage map made from a picture, which the editor's terrain import makes a terrain set's surface and foliage maps with (engine/editor/import/terrain_import.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/runtime/terrain_query/foliage_mas: The foliage map as the game's load keeps it and its sampler over a terrain's grid, which the editor's ground facts and ground overlay read (engine/editor/preview/mission_ground_facts.cpp, mission_ground_overlay.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.godot/src/object/object_data_build.h: The steppable warm-up of a model's data (each material's stage textures and flipbook frames, each level's meshes) the editor's model and definition previews build a large model over several frames with (godot/src/authoring/preview_model.cpp, model_viewport_applier.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.godot/src/register_types.h: The GDExtension entry-point declaration: consumed by its own register_types.cpp plus the .gdextension config's entry_symbol resolution at load time - the linker/loader is the consumer, not an #include.
